column2: ☢ The bunker: can inhabitants become friends, fall out, form a couple?
column3: Yes. Their bond grows by working together, going on a convoy, between master and apprentice; it drops with difficult characters and old quarrels. Friends keep their morale better and work faster when they do the same job; those who can no longer stand each other work more slowly. Two adults who get on very well can form a couple (never two close relatives according to your tree, nor a child); a baby can only be born within a couple. Everything can be seen on the inhabitant’s card (📔 Log → “💞 Their bonds”) and in the game log.

column2: ☢ The bunker: what are “Memories of the ancestors”?
column3: An option in the game settings (switch in the ⚙️ Settings tab, on at first). When an inhabitant taken from your database finds something linked to their real life — their occupation (a joiner in front of a saw, a midwife at the infirmary), their village (a convoy arriving in the town where they were born), a place on their record (the house where they were born) — they tell a short anecdote drawn from their record: their occupation, their birth, their marriage, their children. In a historical scenario, only what had already happened by that date. It appears in a speech bubble and in the log. Never anything about a living person, a confidential record or one hidden from sharing, and nothing is written in your database.

column2: ☢ The bunker: how do I bring back more (bags, wheelbarrow, donkey, boat…)?
column3: What you bring back is counted by weight: water, metal and petrol are heavy, cloth, plants and medicines light. On each person’s back, in addition: rucksacks, back basket, trunk with straps. Only one vehicle per outing, the best for the day’s terrain: wheelbarrow (bad in mud), cart, sledge (only on snow), cargo bike, bike trailer, shopping trolley and reinforced pushchair (present day only, on the road), horse-drawn cart (with a horse: the biggest load), boat (only on water: flooded streets in 1910, riverbanks), mine cart (on rails laid towards a nearby place). Pack animals (donkey or mule, horse), found on farms or traded with a group, carry a lot (+5 with pack saddles and straps) but they have to be fed and watered (on expeditions, in the provisions) and they can get hurt. Vehicles wear out: eventually they need repairing, and you need a workbench. 📦 Supplies tab → “🚚 Transport”.

column2: How do I play battleships or cables?
column3: Open the Game, choose “⚓ Battleships” (against the computer or for two, with ships named after your ancestors) or “🔌 Cables” (turn the cable ends to connect all the stations to the server, with or without wrap-around edges). Games are kept in this browser.

column2: How do I play chess, draughts, dominoes or Yahtzee?
column3: Open the Game, “＋ New game”, then choose “♟️ Chess”, “⛀ Draughts”, “🁫 Dominoes” or “🎲 Yahtzee” in “Game”. For each player, “Who plays”: a person or the computer (easy, medium or hard). With two people, you play on the same screen (in dominoes, a hand-over screen hides the others’ hands). The pieces, counters or computers can bear your ancestors’ names (never a living person or a confidential record). Games are kept in this browser, nothing is written into your genealogy.

column2: Board games: what are the buttons in the bar for?
column3: At the top of the game: who is playing and the scores, the timer, “↶” (⌘Z) which undoes the last move (against the computer, its move too), “💡” (H) which shows a good move (the number says how many are left), “⏸” (Esc) which pauses and hides the board, “?” which explains all the rules, and “⋯” (flip the board, offer a draw, resign). With the keyboard: the arrows to move from square to square, Enter to pick up a piece then put it down. Your record against each computer level is kept with its date.

column2: Chess and draughts: which rules are followed?
column3: Chess: all the official rules — castling (not allowed if the king is in check or passes through an attacked square), en passant, promotion of your choice (queen, rook, bishop or knight), checkmate, stalemate, draw by threefold repetition, by 50 moves without a capture or pawn move and by insufficient material; optional clock (3 to 30 minutes, with or without seconds added per move) and notation in French (R, D, T, F, C). Draughts: international rules on 10 × 10 (compulsory and majority capture, backward capture, flying kings) or English draughts on 8 × 8. A multi-path capture is played square by square.

column2: Yahtzee: how do the score sheet and the bonus work?
column3: Three rolls per turn: touch the dice to keep (they turn blue) before rolling again, then touch a free box in your column (the number of points shows in advance). At the top, the 1s to 6s; if they make 63 points or more, the bonus adds 35 points (“… missing” tells you where you stand). At the bottom: three of a kind, four of a kind, full house (25), small straight (30), large straight (40), Yams (50) and chance. The “American” sheet (Yahtzee) counts three and four of a kind with all 5 dice and gives 100 points for each extra Yahtzee. ↶ undoes the last box filled.

column2: Where can I see all my documents (records, letters, photos) as a list of people?
column3: Show the “📄 Documents” tab: Settings → Appearance → menu tabs (it is hidden at first). The list is on the left, from A to Z with the index letters, or arranged in 📁 folders (like “My diagrams” in Charts: drag a document onto a folder, or “📁 File” from its page; each filing can be undone). The page on the right shows the image in large size, the reference, the date, the people, the transcription; “✎ Edit” opens the media viewer. These are the media of your database: nothing to type in again, and hiding the tab does not touch any document.

column2: How do I see an artist’s catalogue raisonné by albums, by songs or by period?
column3: Show the “🎨 Catalogue raisonné” tab: Settings → Appearance → menu tabs (it is hidden at first). Choose the artist at the top of the column, then “Sort:” — 💽 by albums (the tracks in order, sides A and B), 🎵 by songs (“on 3” shows the albums it appears on), by label, by genre; for a painter 🕰 by period (“⚙️ Periods…”: one per line, e.g. “Blue period 1946-1952”, otherwise by decade), 🖌 by technique, 🏛 by place where it is kept, 🔢 by no.; everywhere by year or A → Z. The sort is remembered for each artist. The record appears on the right; “✎ Edit” opens its catalogue.

column2: Where are the Family treasures (letters to descendants, birth sky, gazette…)?
column3: The ✨ Treasures tab is hidden at first: show it in Settings → Menus, column and lists → Menu. There you find letters to descendants sealed until a date, “At your age…”, dating a photo, the birth sky, the candle, the sound atmosphere, the gazette of the year, embroidery, the Happy Families game, the colouring tree, the passports and many more. Their lists are in Lists → ✨ Family treasures, and 13 widgets go on the dashboard.

column2: Treasures: how do I save, export or print what I have created (colouring, sky, announcement, gazette…)?
column3: All the ✨ Treasures pages are laid out the same way: at the top, “← All treasures”, then the title; on the right the main button (blue), “⤓ Export ▾” and “🖨 Print”. “⤓ Export ▾” brings together the page’s formats (PNG image, SVG drawing, sound file, video…), “📐 Open in the layout” and, at the bottom, “📁 Store a copy in the media”. “🖨 Print” opens the app’s print window (preview, A4 or A5, ⤓ PDF). When the page has a preview, the settings are on the left and the preview on the right (one below the other on a phone).

column2: How do I change the look of a family record book?
column3: On the record book: “🎨 Appearance”. Templates (blue record book of 1877, green of 1975, burgundy, old paper, plain), colours, fonts for the titles and the text (“See all the fonts on my computer” adds yours), sizes, layout, frame, and the order of the parts. A box makes it the look of all your record books.

column2: How do I put a cover image, labels, or save the look of a family record book?
column3: On the record book: “🎨 Appearance” → “Cover image”: choose one of the record book’s photos (“none” to remove it), as a thumbnail on the cover or as a background; it is also used as the image in the list of record books. “💾 Save this look under a name” keeps it in “My looks”, for all record books (× to delete one). Size of the text and titles: slider or box in px (text 8 to 60, titles 8 to 120). “The parts”: the width of each (1, 1/2, 1/3, 2/3, 1/4, 3/4), like widgets. “🏷 Labels” at the top of the record book adds labels (also in “✎ Edit”).

column2: How do I delete a board, or say it is on hold?
column3: In the board, at the top: the list “In progress / On hold / Finished” and the bin 🗑. In the gallery, the bin appears when hovering over a board. The left column sorts by state; the Workshop has the same filters (and the state is chosen in the project settings).

column2: How do I make a record for a pet?
column3: Lists → “Pets” (or People → Animals) → “＋ New animal”. Its record is the full record, like a person’s: name and kennel name, species, breed, sex, coat, markings, height, weight, birth and death, microchip, tattoo, passport, stud book (LOF, LOOF, SIRE…), registration number, DNA, breeder and kennel name, its owners (records from the family), titles and shows, vaccinations, health tests, vet, weight over time (with a curve), the moments of its life, its character, its story, memories, photos and documents (paper pedigree, health book). The animal appears on its owners’ records (“Pets” block, with “＋ An animal”) and in the dashboard’s “Pets” widget (with birthdays).

column2: Can an animal have a record like a person?
column3: Yes, and it is now its only record: tree, events, photos, sources, tables, with its own blocks (🐾 Characteristics, 🌳 Pedigree, 🏆 Titles and shows, 🔖 Rings and markings, 👁 Sightings, 🩺 Health, 👥 Group, 🗺 Map / journeys) arranged in sections. Lists → Pets, People → Animals and “＋ New record” → 🐾 An animal all open this same record.

column2: Does an animal still have two records?
column3: No. Its record is now a single one, like a person’s, with everything the old animal record showed: characteristics, pedigree, titles, rings, sightings, health, group and map, arranged in sections (or tabs). Nothing is lost: an animal that only had the simple record got its full record by itself at the update (a message says so once in the list of animals), and the old links open the record, on the right section.

column2: How do I arrange the blocks of a record in sections (Identity, Family, Life, Documents…)?
column3: Settings → Appearance → Person and animal records → “Record sections”: the style of the titles (Line and title, Framed, Large title, Banner, Centred, or Tabs at the top with the place of the tabs and “▦ See all”), foldable sections (remembered from one record to the next), numbers (1, 2, 3 · I, II, III · A, B, C), block numbers running on or by section, number in brackets in the tabs, empty sections in grey or hidden, sections specific to animals. The drawing (lines, corners, shadows, tabs) follows Designs to choose from, the colour of the banner that of Appearance. Everything is kept straight away.
